summary: K Wave Media Ltd., a Cayman-domiciled Nasdaq-listed (KWM) issuer, filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering a $1.0 million registered direct offering of 526,314 ordinary shares at $1.90 per share to certain institutional investors, priced at a 28.0% discount to the August 18, 2026 last sale of $2.64. The offering closed on or about August 20, 2026, with D. Boral Capital LLC as exclusive placement agent on a reasonable-best-efforts basis at a 7.0% cash fee, yielding $929,996.84 before expenses; no escrow. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
